interface.longDescription: Principal-level domain architecture, reusable engines, module gap tracing, and explicit agent handoffs. By Lex from SigmaStudioz. Domain-first structure, scoped services/shared modules, cohesive engines, and evidence-based verification. Automatic use requires native global instructions. Preview: fresh Cursor CLI passed 16/16 feature checks; Claude passed 15/16 and exceeded the requested agent count. Instructions do not guarantee model adherence.
